PAY-201.description: payment-service rejected or could not complete an operation because a required dependency or invariant failed.
diagnostics: correlate the request ID across gateway and service logs
compare active configuration with the version baseline
inspect dependency saturation and retry rates
PAY-201.remediation: Stabilize the dependency, restore the documented configuration baseline, and verify with a canary request before clearing the alert.

PAY-307.description: Payment authorization result remained indeterminate after the upstream processor deadline.
diagnostics: correlate the request ID across gateway and service logs
compare active configuration with the version baseline
inspect dependency saturation and retry rates
PAY-307.remediation: Query the provider by idempotency key; never blindly repeat authorization. Fixed retry classification ships in 4.3.

DB-104.description: Database connection acquisition timed out before a checkout transaction could begin.
diagnostics: correlate the request ID across gateway and service logs
compare active configuration with the version baseline
inspect dependency saturation and retry rates
DB-104.remediation: For Payment Service 4.2 on PostgreSQL 16 set checkout pool maximumSize to 24, minimumIdle to 6, connectionTimeoutMs to 3000, then deploy 4.2.1, which restores version-aware pool sizing.
